content:
Getting a worth-while learning to the engine room of Indian Corporate Law and Insolvency Resolution has been nothing short of transformative, which is why I am delighted to share with you all, a remarkable chapter of my internship at the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) Guwahati bench, 

My key learnings involved: 

a) Researching on Section 407 to 434 of the Companies Act, 2013. 

b) Preparing case summaries involving Section 7 and Section 9 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 which states the involvement of CIRP with that of the financial creditors. 

c) Prepared a Research note on the entire process of how a company is incorporated, the roles of Insolvency Resolution Process and a Liquidator.

d) Observed various court proceedings on a day-to-day basis. 

This journey would not have been this memorable without the support of my Co-Intern Harsh Jain, who made this internship more exciting and insightful. Lastly, I would like to thank all my seniors, Farhan Masood Zaman, Aditya Prakash, Madona Barman, Nikita Agarwal for guiding me in understanding the intricacies of Corporate Law and the application of it on matters pertaining to it. 

Looking forward to more such opportunities ahead in the future.
